title: Die natürliche Logarithmusfunktion als Stammfunktion von 1/x nutzen (LK)
description: Die lernende Person kann die natürliche Logarithmusfunktion als Stammfunktion von `1/x` verwenden und diese Beziehung in einfachen Integralrechnungen und Begründungen sicher nutzen.
checks: Viewed the actual candidate PNG and checked the integral calculation.
For x>0, (ln x)'=1/x and ∫₁ᵉ1/x dx=1 are correct. The contrasting integral of 1/x² is correctly −1/x+C.
The labelled curve endpoints (1,1) and (e,1/e) carry the right numerical values.
defects: The numerical x-axis is materially nonuniform: the pictured distances 0→1 and e→3 are nearly equal, although their numerical lengths are 1 and approximately 0.282. The interval 1→e is also incompatible with the other unit distances. The graph therefore does not faithfully represent the labelled integration interval on an ordinary linear axis.
nextAction: Keep the algebra and style. Correct the graph to one linear x scale: 0, 1, e≈2.718 and 3, with the shaded interval exactly from 1 to e and corresponding y=1/x points. Verify the y-axis labels on one linear scale as well.
